history.summary: A CDL-built 1,098 sqft 3BR in Pasir Ris, 480m from Pasir Ris MRT/interchange, asking $1,685 PSF — marginally below the $1,696 median, with a healthy 6.3% URA resale CAGR over 234 transactions. The fundamentals are sound and well-priced, but the cluster of ~3,000 CDL units in Pasir Ris Grove (Coco Palms, plus siblings) and further upcoming supply create persistent rental and resale competition that holds this to a solid Buy rather than Strong.
history.rating_rationale: Good value-for-quality: large 944-unit CDL development gives strong liquidity, $1.85M quantum sits in the deep buyer band, $1,685 PSF is just under the $1,696 median (no overpay), and a 6.3% URA resale-only CAGR over a deep 234 transactions evidences real demand. 480m to Pasir Ris MRT plus the future RTS/interchange improvements support D18. Capped at Buy by the well-documented Pasir Ris Grove supply overhang — 3,000+ CDL units clustered together plus additional plots slated nearer the MRT — which intensifies rental competition and could cap resale pricing power; score 711 is good but off-frontier.

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Mixed. Family-friendly large 3BR but the Pasir Ris Grove cluster means heavy direct rental competition; achievable rents and occupancy are pressured versus a standalone development. Yield ~3%.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: Positive but supply-capped. 6.3% historical CAGR is strong, yet ongoing nearby supply limits pricing power; expect appreciation to moderate toward OCR baseline-plus over the hold.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_rate_source: URA resale CAGR (6.3%) discounted for Pasir Ris Grove supply overhang
